slides.texte_overlay:
10 side quests to reset your
entire manhood

1. Sleep one night outside.

2. Build something with wood.

3. Drive to a town you've never
seen, alone.

4. Cook a full dinner for
your family.

5. Fix something you'd
normally replace.

6. Run 10 km once.
Walk if you must.

7. Learn a subject from zero
in 30 days.
slides.texte_sophia:
7. Learn a subject from zero
in 30 days on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
8. Write a letter to your
future son.

9. Apologize to someone
you wronged years ago.

10. Watch a sunrise from
a mountain.
